events.title: Elvis Presley: 49 Years Since We Lost The King
events.blurb: Today marks 49 years since the legendary Elvis Presley, the King of Rock 'n' Roll, passed away in Memphis, Tennessee.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: 49 years ago today, we said goodbye to Elvis Presley. His music and iconic style continue to influence generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential hip-hop artist Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas, an event that led to his death six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 30 years ago today, a pivotal moment in music history. Remembering Tupac Shakur and his incredible impact on hip-hop culture.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: It's 56 years today since the world lost one of its most innovative and influential guitarists, Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in London.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: 56 years ago, the music world lost a true visionary. Jimi Hendrix's legacy continues to burn bright. What's your go-to Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', featuring classics like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Happy 57th birthday to an album that defined a generation! The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped today in '69. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the incomparable Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' icon still rocking. What's your favourite song from the band?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the unmistakable voice of Oasis and a true rock 'n' roll star, Liam Gallagher, born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher's Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Released 51 Years Ago
events.blurb: On this day in 1975, John Lennon released his timeless and powerful anthem for peace, 'Imagine', as a single.

angles.name: Imagine Turns 51
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates globally. What does this track mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod Launched 25 Years Ago
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the very first iPod, a device that would revolutionise portable music and kickstart a new era of digital listening.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years ago today, the original iPod dropped, changing how we carry our tunes forever. What was on your first iPod?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, what's your all-time favourite 007 movie or moment?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incredible life and music of John Lennon. His message of peace still resonates. What's your favourite solo track?

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary actor, comedian, and writer, John Cleese, born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Is 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years of 'The White Album'! The Beatles' ambitious double LP dropped today in '68. Which track from it is your favourite?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury, the flamboyant and powerful lead singer of Queen.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago, we lost a legend. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song to blast?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Is 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal shift in their sound.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years since 'Rubber Soul' changed the game! The Beatles' iconic album dropped today in '65. What's your top track from it?
